name: Milk n' Honey
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead (FS Road 7601 off Icicle Creek Road), hike the Colchuck Lake Trail (#1599) — 4 miles, 2,280 ft gain, forest along Mountaineer Creek with a log-bridge crossing at 1.5 miles, staying right at the Lake Stuart Trail junction, finishing on a boulder moraine to the outlet (2.5-3 hours). Fill water here, the last source. Head toward the lake's south/east side and take the cairned Aasgard Pass climbers' trail up steep talus/heather to about 400 ft above the lake (30-40 min; holds wet snow into July), then break climber's-left through dense slide-alder/heather brush (15-20 minutes) to the base gully system below Colchuck Balanced Rock. Milk n' Honey (5.11) sits in the same general wall area as The Scoop and Rikki Tikki Tavi, toward the right side of the formation; expect loose 3rd/4th-class rock in the final scramble to the base. Figure 3.5-4 hours car-to-base.
